newsitem.title: USA: Novadigm Inc expects drop in Q2 revenues.
newsitem.headline: Novadigm Inc expects drop in Q2 revenues.

text.p: Novadigm Inc said Tuesday it expects this year's second quarter revenues to fall below expectations, coming in at an estimated $4 million.
The quarter ended September 30, and the company said it expects to issue the final results for that period around October 15.
In the 1995 second quarter, the company posted revenues of about $5.56 million. The company did not disclose its original projections for this year's second quarter.

Novadigm Chairman and Chief Executive Albion Fitzgerald said in a statement that the revenue shortfall was the result of continued delays in closing direct sales transactions in North America and Europe.

"We believe that while the shift towards more strategic buying cycles for software management represents a long-term positive trend for the company, the current turbulence in the marketplace caused by the introduction of large competitors has elongated the cycles in the near-term," Fitzgerald said.
